content_html_sanitized:
NORML – The National Organization for the Reform of Marijuana Laws launched an overhauled version of its web site today. While it is still in beta (I can relate to that), it features a clean, crisp, professional look that is easier to navigate. It begins with a great graphic about the arrest statistics.

The home page also has headline links to the NORML weekly press release stories. Allen St. Pierre and I started the weekly PR initially only by fax as both an educational tool for the media and the movement. It was later added to the web site. The site remains an invaluable tool for people wanting to educate themselves on the marijuana issue.

To check it out click here www.norml.org. Remember it is still in beta. It will take them a few days to get everything working perfectly, but this is a great tool for the movement.

It will also make it easier for people to join NORML. (Hint, hint)
